protocol.name: isle_titlebar_v1
protocol.copyright: Isle's own protocol; no other compositor serves it.

description.summary: the compositor's window controls over a client's own toolbar

protocol.description: A window that takes server-side decorations can ask for a transparent title bar, as a macOS window with a full-size content view does: the compositor adds no bar above it and draws only its window controls over the window's own content, at the inset the client names. The client draws everything else, its toolbar included, under them.

request.name: get_titlebar

description.summary: the title bar object for a toplevel's surface

request.description: One per surface; the surface must be an xdg_toplevel's.

description.summary: the title bar back to the compositor's ordinary bar

request.name: set_overlay

description.summary: controls drawn over the window at an inset

request.description: The controls' group is placed with its top leading corner at x, y in logical points from the window geometry's top leading corner. The compositor then adds no bar above the window. Takes effect at once and answers with controls.

event.name: controls

description.summary: the size of the controls' group

event.description: In logical points, so the client keeps its own controls clear of it. Sent after each set_overlay and whenever the size changes.
